title: Humare Rehbar Azeem Rehbar
body:
Humare Rehbar Azeem Rehbar (r.a),
Humari Jaanein Nisaar Unpar... (2)
Yeh Ibne Zehra (s.a),
Yeh Ibne Haider (a.s),
Yeh Ibne Mehdi (a.t.f.s),
Yeh Ibne Sarwar (a.s)...
Humare Rehbar Azeem Rehbar (r.a),
Humari Jaanein Nisaar Unpar...
Dast E Khuda Bar Sar E Maa Khamenei (r.a) Rehbar E Maa,
Taa Khoon Darrag E Maa    Khamenei (r.a) Rehbar E Maa...
Humare Rehbar Azeem Rehbar (r.a),
Humari Jaanein Nisaar Unpar...
Baseeraton Ki Hai Sar Bulaandi,
Ke Aaj Haq Pe Dattey Huwe Hain,
Jo Dushman E Deen Hain Unke Chehre,
Gilazaton Se Attey Huwe Hain,
Zaleel Sab Unki Sazishein Hain,
Khade Hain Maidaa'n Me Yeh Datt Kar...

Humari Jaanein Nisaar Unpar...
